quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Avoid doing something because it is unpleasant.
quests.explanation: 'Shrink from' means to avoid doing something because it's unpleasant. 'He never shrank from a difficult conversation.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Support one person's opinion in an argument.
quests.explanation: To side with someone means to support their opinion in an argument. 'My brother always sides with my mom during family debates.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Carefully assess a person or a situation.
quests.explanation: 'Size up' means to carefully assess a person or a situation. 'The coach sized up the opposing team before the match.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Become less active or less intense.
quests.explanation: 'Slacken off' means to become less active or less intense. 'Traffic usually slackens off after 7 PM.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Reduce the size of a company, team, or product line.
quests.explanation: To slim down a company, team, or product line means to reduce its size. 'The airline slimmed down its routes during the downturn.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Resolve a disagreement carefully and calmly.
quests.explanation: 'Smooth over' means to resolve a disagreement carefully and calmly. 'She managed to smooth things over between the two coworkers.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Quickly recover from a bad mood.
quests.explanation: To snap out of a bad mood means to quickly recover from it. 'It took a funny video to help him snap out of his gloom.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Extend beyond its original limits and affect other areas.
quests.explanation: 'Spill over' means to extend beyond its original limits and affect other areas. 'The dispute spilled over into other departments.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Appear or develop suddenly.
quests.explanation: To spring up means to appear or develop suddenly. 'New cafes seem to spring up on this street every month.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Delay something unwanted for as long as possible.
quests.explanation: 'Stave off' means to delay something unwanted for as long as possible. 'Regular exercise can help stave off certain illnesses.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Originate from a particular cause.
quests.explanation: To stem from a particular cause means to originate from it. 'Her fear of dogs stems from an incident in childhood.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Buy a large supply of something for later use.
quests.explanation: 'Stock up' means to buy a large supply of something for later use. 'We stocked up on canned food before the storm.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Extend in length, distance, or time.
quests.explanation: 'Stretch out' means to extend in length, distance, or time. 'The negotiations stretched out over several weeks.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Begin a conversation or friendship.
quests.explanation: To strike up a conversation or friendship means to begin it. 'They struck up a friendship while waiting for the train.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Remove layers to reveal what is underneath.
quests.explanation: 'Strip away' means to remove layers to reveal what's underneath. 'The renovation stripped away decades of old wallpaper.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Change from using one thing to using another.
quests.explanation: 'Switch over' means to change from using one thing to using another. 'The office switched over to a new software system.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Go somewhere with someone in an informal, uninvited way.
quests.explanation: To tag along means to go somewhere with someone in an informal, uninvited way. 'My little cousin always tags along when we go to the park.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Persuade someone to reduce a price, or speak in a condescending way.
quests.explanation: 'Talk down' can mean to persuade someone to reduce a price, or to speak in a condescending way. 'He managed to talk the seller down to a fair price.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Become involved in a conflict with someone.
quests.explanation: To tangle with someone means to become involved in a conflict with them. 'The company tangled with regulators over the new product.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Join forces with someone to do something together.
quests.explanation: 'Team up' means to join forces with someone to do something together. 'The two charities teamed up for a joint fundraiser.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Succeed at doing something difficult or unusual.
quests.explanation: To carry off something difficult or unusual means to succeed at doing it. 'She carried off the surprise party without him suspecting a thing.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Make sure someone or something is fine by visiting or contacting them.
quests.explanation: 'Check up on' means to make sure someone or something is fine by visiting or contacting them. 'I called to check up on my grandmother after her surgery.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Officially record the time you arrive at work.
quests.explanation: To clock in means to officially record the time you arrive at work. 'Employees have to clock in by 9 AM sharp.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Pretend that something is different from what it really is.
quests.explanation: 'Pass off as' means to pretend that something is different from what it really is. 'He tried to pass off the copy as an original painting.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Remove something gradually, in stages.
quests.explanation: 'Phase out' means to remove something gradually, in stages. 'The city is phasing out plastic bags over the next two years.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Exaggerate the importance of something, or behave badly.
quests.explanation: To play something up means to exaggerate its importance; playing up can also mean behaving badly. 'The ad played up the car's fuel efficiency.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Reject an idea or suggestion firmly.
quests.explanation: 'Shoot down' means to reject an idea or suggestion firmly. 'The board shot down the proposal without much discussion.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: End a message or broadcast, or give formal approval.
quests.explanation: 'Sign off' means to end a message or broadcast, or to give formal approval. 'The news anchor signed off with her usual farewell.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Decide firmly to stop doing something.
quests.explanation: To swear off something means to decide firmly to stop doing it. 'He swore off fast food after his checkup.'

quests.instruction: Select the correct particle to complete the phrasal verb.
quests.hint: DEFINITION: Begin to like a new person or activity quickly.
quests.explanation: 'Take to' means to begin to like a new person or activity quickly. 'She took to her new job right away.'
